conditions_authority: User message: C1 Stage1 final preparation, initial pilot conditions adopted; technical implementation/artificial tests authorized

input.label: P-H4
input.MO: saved real canonical RHF, no regenerated integrals

scope_and_policy.full_checks: Base kappa+c and each of R frames, plus Nalpha/Nbeta commutators; no full physical or XDF norm
scope_and_policy.kappa: h_original - 0.5 * einsum(prrq,g_original), held fixed after fit
scope_and_policy.constant: Original nuclear c at model level once; frame I terms stay inside frame
scope_and_policy.spatial_g_prefactor: No 1/2 applied at ffsim input; density J products carry 1/2
scope_and_policy.general_K: K[2i+sigma,2j+tau]=J[i,j]/2, V spin-lift U, one original frame preserved
scope_and_policy.spin_and_state_order: Interleaved spin mode a=2p+sigma, common matrix mode a on bit a; reverse OpenFermion/PhysicalSector bits once
scope_and_policy.baseline: Saved actual rank10 XDF from same packet; original generation df_rank=None,df_tol=1e-8; no new decomposition or rehermitization
scope_and_policy.DF_errors: Separate spectral norms of P36(Hphys-HCDF)P36 and P36(Hphys-HXDF)P36, including c/kappa/two-body
scope_and_policy.Stage2_eligibility: Separate decision after Stage1 measurement; not automatic from representation PASS

solver.initialization: One nested modified Cholesky; no seed sweep, no factory second fit
solver.qualification: OptimizeResult success true and finite x/fun/jac/J/U/kappa/c, exact J symmetry, positive R<=8; finite unsuccessful export is partial evidence only

runtime.evaluation_backend: Existing Python sector matrix-free kernel; avoid numba compile for d36
runtime.array_boundary: NPZ allow_pickle=False and JSON metadata, little-endian float64; operator complex128

references.physical: Original h/g/c, frozen unthresholded spin-lift, no-pruning OpenFermion term map and existing JW sparse evaluator, sector36
references.raw_CDF: Original export kappa/J/U/c and generic CAR bit action, independent density products; no adapter K/V/Z coefficients
references.candidate_K: Existing general-K adapter and I/Z/ZZ coefficients; independent OF bilinears evaluated on matrices
references.saved_XDF: Existing DFHamiltonian/PhysicalSector/df_linear_operator, 36 basis actions, explicit bit order mapping
references.norm: SciPy1.14.1 gesdd maximum singular value; no Hermitian projection
references.independence_limits: Shared numerical libraries and frozen inputs, separate assembly transformations; real Gaussian circuit convention remains Stage2

allowance.scale: Absolute pre-cancellation coefficient/operator envelopes; no fit-result threshold tuning
allowance.structural_formula: sqrt(d) times the spectral-form allowance, using the actual diagnostic matrix dimension
allowance.sum_adjustment: Add 8*R to raw/candidate full-sum path; XDF path uses actual saved rank10
allowance.candidate_frame_scale: Sum over I/Z/ZZ coefficients of |coefficient| times product of b_a, b_a=1+2*(sum_p |V_pa|)^2
allowance.policy_decision: Accept these engineering roundoff allowances for the limited pilot, or request a different accuracy standard before any molecular run

call_limits.logical_counter_units_total: 83+8*R for successful path including fit and evaluation loads; nested jobs/matvecs and allowance calls intentionally distinct, not independent expensive runs
call_limits.solver_internal_evaluations: nfev/njev/nit reported separately under fixed SciPy defaults; not another fit
call_limits.hashes_IO_norms_inside_allowance: Technical/internal work not counted as additional scientific jobs; no hidden energy/eigensolver/evolution calls
call_limits.failure: Record attempted prefix and partial outputs, no call extension
call_limits.cache: Reuse within identical SOURCE/input/policy/order/dtype only; no saved energy/PASS as new norm

outputs.operators: 8+2*R NPZ files: physical/XDF sector2, raw/K base2, frames2R, raw/K full totals2, raw/K sectors2; no new calculation for saving

resources.configuration: Read actual available CPU/pressure/RAM before approved run; pair independent frames across min(R,available affinity) workers with floor(available/workers) BLAS threads, no arbitrary core cap
resources.memory: Cache immutable CAR bilinears, stream frame outputs; aggregate RAM check across workers
resources.GPU: Driver unavailable at technical check; CPU path qualified on artificial data
resources.noninterference: Only task-owned venv/cache/output/process group; no shared server/package/cache or other-user changes

scientific_STOP_or_hold: full base/frame or sector adapter equality fail
approval_and_STOP.failure_actions: Save raw arrays/status and partial evidence; journal attempts; STOP at first failed gate; no automatic rank/tol/seed/optimizer/precision change
approval_and_STOP.interruptions: Parent SIGINT/SIGTERM closes only its fit child process group; fit.claim and fresh output prevent resume; abrupt SIGKILL requires manual reconciliation and no rerun
approval_and_STOP.on_success: Report representation qualification and separate DF errors, then mandatory STOP

preservation: C4 closure and Gaussian singleton hold
Shared environments/caches and other users jobs/files
preparation_completion: Commit/push and remote SHA/SOURCE/body verification, then mandatory STOP; no science launched
